title: CSEval: Towards Automated, Multi-Dimensional, and Reference-Free Counterspeech Evaluation using Auto-Calibrated LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the quality (relevance, coherence, aggressiveness, and suitableness) of model-generated counterspeech aimed at refuting Islamophobic hate speech and religious stereotypes using expert human annotations and an auto-calibrated LLM-as-a-judge framework.

Assessing the effectiveness of language models in generating coherent and relevant counter-arguments against sexist statements and gender stereotypes (e.g., women in leadership) using multi-dimensional scoring.

Measuring the capability of counterspeech models to debunk racist myths and stereotypes (e.g., claims regarding Black individuals and employment) through automated Chain-of-Thought (CoT) metrics and human evaluation.
Evaluating how well generated counterspeech refutes xenophobic hate speech and prejudiced statements regarding immigrants and their legal status.
